patch_description:
This change improves handling of scan and uniform-distribution workloads by:
1. Adding sequential scan detection via tracking folio indices and strides
2. Implementing access-count decay so older accesses matter less
3. Smoothing burst detection to reduce noise
4. Making hot-folio protection less aggressive to avoid keeping stale entries

All changes stay within the EVOLVE-BLOCK by using existing metadata map and adding helper functions.
